definition_in_use.fhs_principal: an independent lane: its own process, its own model, its own evidence path, its own verdict artefact, and no write access to the candidate it judges

what_this_definition_does_not_claim: distinct OS accounts (all three lanes run under one Windows user)
SOD006-C4 independence between PLAN and VERIFY (same arm, owner-ordered, declared)
that same-host correlated blind spots are absent

conditions_the_blueprint_attaches_to_aut.technical_permission_separation: SATISFIED_AT_LANE_LEVEL - separate processes, separate models, read-only candidate, separate evidence paths; NOT satisfied at account level and not claimed

consequence: FHS_ORIGINAL_ACK 6/6 may be issued by the reader role instantiated as lanes, signed under the owner key, provided each receipt carries spans, a biting negative fixture, and a closed disagreement record.
